paragraphs: At shift handover, review the day's examination list and verify body regions. Bring patients into the imaging room, explain procedures, apply protection, and position them. Activate the exposure, inspect image quality, and repeat inadequate studies. In the afternoon, perform consecutive CT and X-ray exams and reassure anxious patients. Before leaving, clean equipment and organize records.
